::: {#hero-heading}
Welcome!

I'm Zhiqiang Wang, a Xingnong Young Scholar at the College of Economics and Management, China Agricultural University. I received my Ph.D. in Economics from the School of Economics, Peking University in 2026 and my B.A. in Economics from the same institution in 2021.

My research interests lie in environmental economics and the economics of climate change, with a particular interest in quantitative economic history. My current research focuses on how climate shocks shape adaptation in the industrial sector.

I welcome discussions and collaborations.





:::
